name: Salmon Burger with Dill, Caper Aioli & Spinach-Apple Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 sticks celery
3 Gala apples
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Drain salmon, place in a medium bowl, and flake with a fork; add eggs, bread crumbs, mayo, and spices. Stir to combine the salmon mixture, form into 6 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 g) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style
3 eggs
1 cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; mince capers. Place both in a small bowl, add mayo, and stir to combine the aioli; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp capers
⅓ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add salmon patties and cook until browned and warmed through, about 5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples; add to the bowl along with spinach and cranberries. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
To assemble the burgers, spread the bottom half of each bun with aioli; layer with a salmon patty and the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
